evidence.quote: In this six-semester program with 180 ECTS, students earn managerial competencies
English is the only language of instruction.

All international applicants with international university entrance qualifications (e.g. secondary level education qualifications) must also apply via uni-assist (you can have your documents reviewed by uni-assist at any time throughout the year).

Please note that the uni-assist application needs to be completed before the end of the application period, however, the document that the uni-assist will provide you with (VPD), can be handed in later, even after the application period has ended.

notes: Evidence pages other than the two programme pages (DAAD and TUM study fees) were used where they directly describe this programme or international applicants. No tuition fee for non-EU students is stated on this programme's pages (both say 'No tuition fees'); the general TUM non-EU fee page (2,000 or 3,000 euros per semester) may not apply, so tuition is left out. The deadline 'July 15' is stated without a year, so no ISO date is given; it applies to the winter semester intake each year. The admission requirement 'Letter of motivation – maximum two A4 pages' is not included as a document because the page's document list is only described by a link.
